No dividend will be declared for the current year as cash is reserved for growth initiatives.
The company received USD 689 million from the DyStar matter, strengthening the balance sheet.

timeline.summary: Equinaire Holdings executed an agreement to acquire a USD 9.76 mn loan for the MCB Copper-Gold Project in the Philippines.
Kiri Industries received warning letters from BSE and NSE on April 27, 2026, for delayed disclosure regarding the DyStar SPA extension.
Kiri Industries filed the monitoring agency report from CRISIL for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹398.41 Cr utilized from preferential issue proceeds.
Manishkumar P Kiri, as promoter, declared no new encumbrances by Kiri Industries’ promoter group for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹250.5 Cr (+22.2% YoY), net profit ₹514.36 Cr (against a loss of ₹84.64 Cr a year earlier).
Kiri Industries Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4-FY26/FY26 earnings conference call held on June 01, 2026, at 10:30 AM (IST) via its website.
Kiri Industries held its Q4FY26 earnings call on June 1, 2026, outlining progress on its ₹8,100 Cr copper and fertilizer project and FY27 outlook.
Kiri Industries' wholly owned subsidiary Equinaire Holdings completed the registration process for acquiring 2,00,00,000 shares (40% stake) in Makilala Mining Company, Inc.
